answer: Correlated-answer detection: each round the network compares submissions pairwise, and identities whose texts or timing cluster unusually tightly share one reward pool instead of earning separately. A farm of fakes looks like a lagoon fed by one hidden spring, so splitting into many names gains nothing. The attacker's payoff drops to its nadir unless every clone pays for truly independent work, which removes the cheap oasis Sybils hope for.
